i feel like this is a dumb user question ,but anyway, trying to run geth to play with withdrawals based on https://hackmd.io/-7X3aN3KRvOcY2TsDbFcvQ and get told
```
ERROR[11-17|17:16:59.433] Cannot start mining without etherbase    err="etherbase must be explicitly specified"
```

running geth with:
```
./build/bin/geth --http \
    --datadir=$HOME/capella/data/geth \
    --nodiscover \
    --syncmode=full \
  --allow-insecure-unlock \
    --mine \
  --authrpc.jwtsecret=$HOME/capella/template/jwtsecret.txt
```
